name: Echo CS-4910
blurb: .325″ pitch, .050″ gauge, 3/16″ file: 66 drive links on 16″, 72 on 18″, 78 on 20″ (20BPX), per Echo's bars chart.
intro: The CS-4910 has its own rows in Echo's Bars and Chains chart, separate from the CS-4920. All three are .325″ pitch, .050″ gauge, 20BPX chain, 3/16″ file: 66 drive links on 16″ (bar 16F0AD3366C), 72 on 18″ (bar 18F0AD3372C) and 78 on 20″ (bar 20F0AD3378C). Echo's specification table in this catalog does not print a displacement for the CS-4910, so none is stated here.
